values.description:
ModeShape is a lightweight, fast, and pluggable JCR repository that federates and unifies content from multiple systems, including files systems, databases, configuration files, other repositories, services, applications, and data grids. Your applications see and use the standard JCR API, letting ModeShape hide the gory details and work behind the scenes to automatically extract everything it can from your content. ModeShape lets your information take shape so you can make the most of it.

ModeShape was formerly called JBoss DNA.
